relation: two separate representations, each definitional: Hom U3 is_path is seq_simple_walk s; Cycle U6 is_path is Cycle.foundations.path_subgraphs.path_subgraph P
summary: Batch B, family B7 (`is_path`): the two remaining helpers named `is_path`, two separate representation classes kept apart in registry and certificates. SEQUENCE class: Hom U3's boolean `is_path s := uniq s && (if s is x :: p then path (--) x p else true)` now unfolds to `GTBase.walks_paths.seq_simple_walk s` (`uniq s && sorted (--) s`), convertible; the empty sequence is accepted, which is exactly where it differs from family simple-path's nonempty `seq_simple_path` (`seq_simple_path_walk`, `seq_simple_walk_path`), and on `x :: q` it is coq-graph-theory's `upath x (last x q) q`. MULTIGRAPH class: Cycle U6's edge-set `is_path P` (nonempty, connected, acyclic, arc-end degree at most two) now unfolds to `Cycle.foundations.path_subgraphs.path_subgraph P`, convertible: the new foundations module imports only `Cycle.foundations.connectivity`, and its `acyclic_edge_set` has U6's `acyclic` body verbatim (U6's own `acyclic`, also used by `spanning_tree`, is unchanged). Loops and parallel edges keep their behaviour: a loop is a circuit and is never in a path, two distinct parallel edges form a circuit, a single non-loop edge is a path (proved generically and grounded on concrete multigraphs in the public client).

Two rows are affected: U3's three-longest-paths OPG row through `longest_path` (nonempty connected graph, three longest sequences, a common vertex) and U6's path-decomposition OPG row through `path_decomposition` (positive vertices and edges, simple and connected multigraph, an edge partition into paths, at most `(n + 1) %/ 2` of them). Both chains and rows are frozen (U3/U6 names carry no wave prefix, so the frozen chain copies are named `u3_longest_path` and `u6_path_decomposition`). The grounding files of U3 and U6 rebuild unchanged. No migration declaration reaches either source at the B6 baseline, so no historical original is owed.

Kernel evidence, independent of this textual report: `Print All Dependencies` of the two frozen statements contains no live helper or chain declaration of this family and neither canonical, while each live statement reaches its canonical (/srv/graph-theory-rocq/coordination/evidence/B7-is_path/print_all_dependencies_summary.txt).
No statement text, doc block, manifest row or leg state changes (checked below). B6's `seq_simple_path`, U9's `spath` (no uniqueness) and XE2's walk stay distinct contracts.
